title: The Fills a Ridgecrest RxSecure Out-of-Pocket Total Is Gathered Over
content:
The span of fills over which an out-of-pocket total is gathered on a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan is read from the number of fills standing paid on the pharmacy record for the contract year and from the standing of the enrollment. The plan treats 4 or more such fills as a long fill history.

1. Where the member's fills standing paid on the pharmacy record for the contract year are 4 or more and the enrollment stands in force, the total is gathered over every fill standing paid on the record.
2. Where the member's fills standing paid on the pharmacy record for the contract year are fewer than 4 and the enrollment stands in force, the total is gathered over the fills standing paid with a fill date in the 6 months up to the handling date.
3. Where neither holds, the total is gathered over the fills standing paid with a fill date in the 3 months up to the handling date.

| Fills standing paid for the contract year | Standing of the enrollment | The fills gathered over |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4 or more | in force | every fill standing paid on the record |
| fewer than 4 | in force | those with a fill date in the 6 months up to the handling date |
| 4 or more | in its premium grace period, terminated, or any other footing | those with a fill date in the 3 months up to the handling date |
| fewer than 4 | in its premium grace period, terminated, or any other footing | those with a fill date in the 3 months up to the handling date |

A record carrying exactly 4 fills standing paid meets the long fill history; one carrying 3 does not.

## Worked on a hypothetical record

Take a record carrying 5 fills standing paid for the contract year with member payments totalling 210.00 USD, of which 4 fills totalling 160.00 USD fall in the 6 months up to the handling date and 2 fills totalling 60.00 USD in the 3 months up to the handling date.

- With the enrollment in force: the total is gathered over every fill, giving 210.00 USD.
- Had only 3 fills stood paid, with the enrollment in force, the total would be gathered over the 6-month window.
- With the enrollment in its premium grace period: the total is gathered over the 3-month window, giving 60.00 USD.
